regions.today: Cool and blustery this evening with scattered showers.
regions.tonight: Showers becoming well scattered overnight with clear spells developing. Lowest temperatures of 4 to 7 degrees in mainly moderate northwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: Scattered showers again tomorrow, turning heavy in places in the afternoon. They'll clear from the north through the later afternoon and evening with brighter spells developing. Another cool day with highest temperatures of 10 to 13 degrees in a brisk northerly wind.
